notes: Vanilla Assassination at 60 does not have Envenom or a real Mutilate rotation -- those are later-expansion redesigns. The Forever talent tree adds a talent-granted Mutilate (spell 1310707, rank 1) and a Venom proc (1310703) to this tree, and per the brief's rule for a Forever talent tree that adds an ability the engine does not model yet, both are named here anyway -- as the intended combo-point builder ahead of Sinister Strike, and as an alternate finisher choice ahead of Eviscerate. Neither has a dedicated implementation under sim/rogue (grep only finds them in the auto-generated talent aura table, not in a file of their own the way sinister_strike.go or eviscerate.go exist), so the engine's own ValidationWarning (sim/core/apl_helpers.go) will warn and skip these two lines rather than cast them, which is exactly the mechanism the brief describes; falling through, the rotation still runs on the vanilla Sinister Strike / Eviscerate loop underneath, which is also what the live Era guide recommends since vanilla Assassination never had Mutilate. Cold Blood is popped right before the finisher for a guaranteed crit. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst.
